title: Help a New Visitor Use the Library
instructions: Record the model, then give your own explanation with different details.
prompt: Explain how to use a real or imagined library. Say how to find a suitable book, where two facilities are, what visitors can and cannot do, and how to borrow or reserve a book. Give a reason for one rule. Speak for about 75–105 seconds.
reference: Welcome to our library. You can search for a book by its title, author or topic on this computer. Read the description before you select it. The science section is beside the window, and there is a dictionary on the reference table. You can use reference books here, but you cannot take them home. Please keep quiet near the study desks because other people are reading. With your library card, you can take a normal book home for two weeks. If another reader has the book you want, ask the librarian to reserve it. Check the return date before you leave.
